source.notes: KRX closes on weekdays that are public holidays (incl. substitute holidays), Labor Day and the last day of the year. Built before KRX published its 2027 schedule: public holidays from python-holidays 0.105 (KR, 2026 law: Constitution Day and Labor Day are public holidays with substitute holidays), lunar dates cross-checked with korean-lunar-calendar and pandas-market-calendars XKRX. The 2026 law was checked against real 2026 KRX data (no trading on 2026-05-01 and 2026-07-17). Re-verify against the official KRX 2027 schedule (published around December 2026); any change requires a new file digest and successor manifest.

closures.2027-05-03: Labor Day substitute holiday (2026 law; confirm with KRX)
closures.2027-07-19: Constitution Day substitute holiday (2026 law; confirm with KRX)
closures.2027-12-31: Last KRX trading day of the year
